text:
emma: Quick heads-up  my sister is dropping by at 10:30 with a newborn in a bassinet and a framed mirror for her apartment. Can we have a visitor badge and a spot near the west bench? Also I might have a brown box arriving  could you hold it? :baby::frame_photo:
front-desk: All good. Guests sign in and get a day badge. We can reserve the west bench (outlet limited). Packages go to locker G1. Please give the guest name for the badge.
emma: Name is 'Nina Alvarez'. The box might be "Emma R. - kitchen kit". Mirror is heavy but not oversized.
reception-bot: Guest badge queued for "Nina Alvarez" at 10:20. Badge ID G-7211.
rishi: Heads-up: if mirror needs carrying we can request a facilities porter but it might take 10-15 mins. @facilities can you standby?
olga: Also note: newborns + coffee = we have to be extra careful around hot drinks. If anyone has the office latte please keep it away from the west bench.
mailroom: Package "Emma R. - kitchen kit" arrived at 10:12. Smallish box, no obvious damage. Placed in locker G1 and labeled. No weird smells.
facilities: Porter available. If the mirror is just a frame we can help move it from loading dock to north lounge and leave it on a mat. ETA 10:35.
sam: Quick question: can guests use the family room (nursing) while visiting? I thought it's first-come-first-served.
front-desk: Family room key at reception. We can hand it over when guest checks in. Reminder: please return key when finished.
emma: Thanks, can we reserve the family room key from 10:30-11:15 if available? Nina might need it briefly.
reception-bot: Family room reserved for guest "Nina Alvarez" from 10:30 to 11:15.
front-desk: Guest checked in at 10:29. Badge handed. Porter notified for mirror. Kitten-level vibes observed (newborn cuddles).
mailroom: Small note: someone accidentally labeled another parcel "Emma R." earlier today. We crosschecked and the right one is in G1 now. All sorted.
facilities: Porter moved the mirror to north lounge and placed it on a mat at 10:38. Sticker "Do not tip" attached. We used twin dolly and had a hand-off with Nina.
olga: All good  family room key returned at 11:05. Baby napping now. Please keep the area quiet.
emma: You're all saints, thank you. One more favor  can someone pick up the box from G1 and bring it to the west bench? I have a call at 11:30 and can't leave my sister alone with the mirror.
sam: I can swing by in 10 mins and drop it off.
mailroom: Parcel picked up from G1 by Sam at 11:12 and placed by the west bench. Sticky note "Emma R. - kitchen kit" attached.
rishi: Closing loop: mirror staged, family room used and returned, package delivered to bench. All set. :party_popper:
